It's easy to handle, but its core is made of wood, so it can catch fire.|Inventory|TotK}} Soldier's Shields go unnamed in {{AoC}}. ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Shield |strength = 16 |durability = 16 |flammable = Yes |magnetic = No |buoyant = Yes |conductive = No |guardian = No |throw = |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Soldier's Shield}} Soldier's Shields are mid-grade [[Shield]] known to have once been used by the guards of [[Hyrule Castle]]. They belong to the [[Soldier's Gear]] equipment archetype, a series of [[Weapon]]s intended for soldiers of [[Hyrule Kingdom]].{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 169}} They boast a moderately high defense rating as well as a decent durability. They can be found almost anywhere throughout Hyrule Kingdom, though an easy spot is [[Snowfield Stable]] on the [[Tabantha Tundra]]. A Soldier's Shield is sold by [[Russ]] on [[Trilby Plain]] for 100 [[Rupee]]s.{{Cite|The {{Color BotW|Blue|soldier's shield}}? A reliable choice for combat or the slopes, sure. How's about {{Color BotW|Red|100 rupees}}?|Russ|BotW}} When Link buys it, Russ calls him a bona fide [[Shield Surfing|Shield Surfer]], and he then shares the legend of [[Selmie]].{{Cite|Thanks, my man! Now you're a bona fide shield surfer! By the way, have ya heard about the legend? Pretty epic. The legend of the shield-surfing world is {{Color BotW|Blue|Selmie}}! When {{Color BotW|Blue|Selmie}} boarded a shield, nothin' could stand in her way. Everybody who saw her tear it up was practically hypnotized! That's raw skill, man. She retired young and became a living legend. They say she settled down in the {{Color BotW|Blue|Hebra Mountains}} to the northwest. If you're serious about shield surfing, maybe you should track her down. {{Small|{{Color BotW|Gray|Actually, lots of folks have tried to meet her...and they all ran into trouble along the way.}}}}|Russ|BotW}} Selmie also gives Link a Soldier's Shield for completing the [[Shield-Surfing (Mini-Game)|Shield-Surfing]] [[Mini-Game]] with a time between 2:00 and 2:15.{{Cite|A shiny new record deserves a shiny new shield. Here y'go!|Selmie|BotW}} The following [[amiibo]] have a chance to spawn a [[Treasure Chest]] containing a Soldier's Shield when they are scanned with the [[Amiibo (Ability)|amiibo]] [[Rune]]: * {{SSB}} Series [[Link]] amiibo * {{TLoZ Series}} Series [[Link]] ({{TLoZ}}) amiibo * {{TLoZ|-}} Series [[Toon Zelda]] ({{TWW}}) amiibo * {{TLoZ|-}} Series [[Link]] ({{TP}}) amiibo * {{TLoZ|-}} Series [[Link]] ({{SS}}) amiibo * {{BotW}} Series [[Princess Zelda|Zelda]] amiibo * {{BotW|-}} Series [[Urbosa]] amiibo Despite their appearance, Soldier's Shields have a core made of wood, and therefore can burn when exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. In addition, the [[Magnesis]] Rune will not work on them, and they cannot conduct [[Electricity]] or attract [[Lightning]] during [[Thunderstorm]]s. Finally, they will float if they are dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]]. {{BotW Shield Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Shield_002" |Life = 16 |GuardPower = 16 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 2 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 4 |SharpWeaponAddGuardMin = 6 |SharpWeaponAddGuardMax = 12 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 5 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 6 |PoweredSharpAddGuardMin = 13 |PoweredSharpAddGuardMax = 23 |RideBreakRatio = 1.0 |MirrorLevel = 0 |SurfingFriction = 1.0 }} ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{TotK Item Properties/Store |type = Shield |strength = 16 |durability = |flammable = Yes |magnetic = |buoyant = No |conductive = No |guardian = }} {{Compendium/Extract/TotK|Soldier's Shield}} {{Stub|TotK}} Soldier's Shields are wielded by several members of the [[Monster-Control Crew, Squad One]]. ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} Soldier's Shields can be wielded by [[Link]] in conjunction with [[Soldier's Broadsword]]s. {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:BotW Akkala Highlands Promotional Screenshot.png|Link with a Soldier's Shield in {{BotW|-}} File:AoC Soldier's Shield Model.png|A Soldier's Shield from {{AoC|-}} File:AoC Link Artwork.png|Link using a Soldier's Shield from {{AoC|-}} File:AoC Hylian Soldier Icon.png|Icon of a Soldier with a Soldier's Shield from {{AoC|-}} == See also == {{See Also| * Shield * Soldier's Gear }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Shields, Soldier's Gear |items= BotW, TotK, AoC }}
